response.sql:
SELECT m.college,
       SUM(i.amount) AS total_income_amount,
       CAST(SUM(i.amount) AS REAL) /
           (SELECT SUM(amount) FROM income) AS fraction_of_all_income
FROM income AS i
JOIN member AS mb ON mb.member_id = i.link_to_member
JOIN major AS m ON m.major_id = mb.link_to_major
GROUP BY m.college;

assumptions.assumption: The fraction is the college's matched income total divided by the total amount across every income record, including records with no linked member or major. Colleges with no matched income are not shown.
